cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC世界服务部的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton, and in the early hours of Saturday, September 19th, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是西莉亚·哈顿。现在是9月19日星期六凌晨，以下是本台主要新闻。

cues.en: And the governor of California, Gavin Newsom, wants more safety rules around AI, perhaps even a kill switch.
cues.zh: 加州州长加文·纽瑟姆希望加强人工智能安全规则，甚至可能设置“关闭开关”。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: if anyone finds that fun, I'm not sure they understand games in the conventional definition.
cues.zh: 本期还将谈到：如果有人觉得那很有趣，我不确定他们是否理解通常定义下的游戏。

cues.en: A board game that's being played in England that's so complex, no one has ever finished it.
cues.zh: 英国有人正在玩一种极其复杂的桌游，从来没人完成过一局。

cues.en: We'll begin in Washington, where there's been a series of announcements from the White House.
cues.zh: 我们先从华盛顿开始，白宫接连发布了多项消息。

cues.en: And in another potentially important move, Mr Trump has banned a number of major media organizations from the White House.
cues.zh: 另一项可能重要的举动是，特朗普禁止多家主要媒体机构进入白宫。

cues.en: And Sarah, we are speaking to you on a big day for the White House press pool.
cues.zh: 莎拉，今天对白宫记者团来说是重要的一天。

cues.en: President Trump appears to have banned three news organizations, CNN, Politico, and MSNBC, from reporting from the White House.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统似乎禁止三家新闻机构——CNN、《政客》和MSNBC——在白宫进行报道。

cues.en: What more do you know?
cues.zh: 你还了解到什么？

cues.en: Well, he announced this in a Truth Social post on social media, saying that he was sick of their constant fake news reporting
cues.zh: 他在社交媒体Truth Social上发帖宣布此事，说自己受够了这些媒体持续不断的假新闻报道。

cues.en: and that these three media organizations would be banned from the White House.
cues.zh: 并称这三家媒体机构将被禁止进入白宫。

cues.en: And then he took questions in the Oval Office from some other reporters who were in there and didn't give us a huge amount of detail.
cues.zh: 随后，他在椭圆形办公室接受了在场其他记者的提问，但没有向我们透露太多细节。

cues.en: So we don't know whether these organizations are banned from the grounds of the White House
cues.zh: 所以我们不知道，这些机构是否被禁止进入白宫园区，

cues.en: and from the press briefing room, or whether it is only from the Oval Office, from press conferences, and traveling with President Trump on Air Force One.
cues.zh: 还是只被禁止进入椭圆形办公室、参加新闻发布会以及乘坐空军一号随特朗普总统出行。

cues.en: He also said there was no particular reason why he was doing this now.
cues.zh: 他还说，自己现在这样做没有什么特别的原因。

cues.en: There was no individual story that he was taking objection to that had prompted him to do this move.
cues.zh: 也没有哪一篇具体报道引起他的反感，促使他采取这一行动。

cues.en: He just said that the constant negative and fake reporting had annoyed him so much he wanted to take this action
cues.zh: 他只是说，持续不断的负面和虚假报道让他非常恼火，因此想采取这一行动，

cues.en: because he said it was diminishing his Republican Party.
cues.zh: 因为他说，这正在削弱共和党。

cues.en: And, of course, it is worth remembering that we're only a few weeks away from some crucial midterm elections.
cues.zh: 当然，值得记住的是，距离几场关键的中期选举已经只有几周时间。

cues.en: He did mention the possibility that he might want to go on and ban other organizations.
cues.zh: 他确实提到，可能还想继续禁止其他机构。

cues.en: He mentioned off the top of his head the New York Times, the Washington Post and ourselves, and the BBC
cues.zh: 有人问到时，他脱口提到了《纽约时报》、《华盛顿邮报》、我们以及BBC，

cues.en: all of whom he said were purveyors of fake news,
cues.zh: 他说这些都是假新闻的传播者，

cues.en: but he doesn't appear to be making a move in that direction at the moment. Our North America editor, Sarah Smith.
cues.zh: 但目前看来，他并没有朝这个方向采取行动。我们的北美编辑莎拉·史密斯。

cues.en: For weeks now, we've heard warning after warning about artificial intelligence and the potential threat it poses to humanity.
cues.zh: 几周以来，我们不断听到关于人工智能及其可能对人类构成威胁的警告。

cues.en: Many of the world's biggest AI companies are based in California
cues.zh: 世界上许多最大的人工智能公司都位于加利福尼亚，

cues.en: and now the state's Democratic Governor, Gavin Newsom, has announced he's setting up a panel to look at ways to strengthen safety rules around the technology
cues.zh: 如今该州的民主党州长加文·纽森宣布，将成立一个小组，研究加强这项技术安全规则的方法，

cues.en: including the possibility of what's being called a kill switch.
cues.zh: 其中包括设立所谓“关闭开关”的可能性。

cues.en: In a video posted to social media, he called on Mike Johnson, the Republican House Speaker in Washington, to do the same.
cues.zh: 他在社交媒体发布的一段视频中呼吁共和党籍众议院议长迈克·约翰逊也这样做。

cues.en: We're going to convene experts to figure out the right path forward.
cues.zh: 我们将召集专家，找出正确的前进方向。

cues.en: California will do what it can, but this nation needs to get in the game. Washington, D.C. needs to do its job.
cues.zh: 加州会尽其所能，但美国需要行动起来。华盛顿特区需要履行职责。

cues.en: Remarkably, they left for a summer break.
cues.zh: 令人惊讶的是，他们去过暑假了。

cues.en: Mike Johnson should return from vacation and follow California's lead by passing national legislation. Get it done.
cues.zh: 迈克·约翰逊应该结束休假，效仿加州通过全国性立法。把这件事办成。

cues.en: Earlier in the week, Donald Trump said that fears about the safety of AI are a hoax and rejected calls for greater safeguards.
cues.zh: 本周早些时候，唐纳德·特朗普称对人工智能安全的担忧是骗局，并拒绝了加强防护措施的呼吁。

cues.en: Callie Hayes is our tech reporter in San Francisco. She told me more about what this panel in California might be exploring.
cues.zh: 卡莉·海斯是我们驻旧金山的科技记者。她向我介绍了加州这个委员会可能探讨的内容。

cues.en: I think some of the key things that they would be looking at would be, one,
cues.zh: 我认为，他们要研究的几个关键事项之一是，

cues.en: getting third parties to come in and actually look at these models as they're developed.
cues.zh: 让第三方参与进来，实际查看这些模型的开发过程。

cues.en: The models are the basis of, you know, things like AI chatbots.
cues.zh: 这些模型是人工智能聊天机器人等事物的基础。

cues.en: So just getting somebody that is not inside one of these companies coming in and being able to look at what is going into the training
cues.zh: 所以，就是让不属于这些公司的外部人士参与进来，查看训练数据中加入了什么，

cues.en: and saying, hey, that's maybe not the best idea, or don't you think that behavior is weird, that kind of a thing.
cues.zh: 并指出：这或许不是最好的做法，或者说，这种行为难道不奇怪吗？大概就是这样。

cues.en: But one of the biggest things that I think that people are starting to take seriously is this idea of a quote-unquote kill switch.
cues.zh: 但我认为，人们开始认真对待的最大问题之一，就是所谓的“关闭开关”。

cues.en: which sounds very dramatic, and it kind of is, but basically governments and authorities want some way to actually force
cues.zh: 这听起来非常戏剧化，某种程度上确实如此；但基本上，各国政府和主管机构希望能强制

cues.en: an AI company to turn off or shut down an AI tool that has started acting improperly.
cues.zh: 人工智能公司关闭或停止一个已经开始不当运行的人工智能工具。

cues.en: Do you think that this panel could reach any kind of agreement on this huge issue?
cues.zh: 你认为这个委员会能就这一重大问题达成某种共识吗？

cues.en: Tech bosses appear to be very split on how much regulation they'd like to see happen when it comes to AI.
cues.zh: 科技公司老板们对于人工智能需要多少监管，似乎存在严重分歧。

cues.en: I think any kind of broad agreement would be next to impossible.
cues.zh: 我认为，达成任何广泛共识都几乎不可能。

cues.en: I think they would definitely also fight tooth and nail against the idea of a kill switch.
cues.zh: 我认为，他们肯定也会竭力反对设置关闭开关。

cues.en: They really do not want outside people being able to tell them what to do, when.
cues.zh: 他们确实不希望外部人士能够告诉他们该做什么、何时去做。

cues.en: But that said, my cynical side coming out, there are things already agreed on regarding what needs to be done with AI safety,
cues.zh: 不过，话虽如此，我悲观的一面认为，在人工智能安全需要做什么这件事上，已经有一些共识，

cues.en: and the idea of third parties looking at models and having a say in what goes into them is gaining a lot of traction,
cues.zh: 让第三方查看模型，并对模型中加入什么发表意见的想法，正获得越来越多支持，

cues.en: and I think there has already kind of turned up a consensus that this would be a good idea.
cues.zh: 我认为，人们已经逐渐形成共识，认为这会是个好主意。

cues.en: But President Trump doesn't appear keen to regulate the market at all, and we also have to remember that
cues.zh: 但特朗普总统似乎完全不愿监管市场；还要记住，

cues.en: President Trump and Gavin Newsom, the governor of California, are political rivals.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统和加州州长加文·纽森是政治对手。

cues.en: They are political rivals, but it's funny that they tend to listen to the same people.
cues.zh: 他们是政治对手，但有趣的是，他们往往听取同一批人的意见。

cues.en: I mean, Trump definitely has been vehement that he does not want to have any involvement in regulating AI at all,
cues.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普一直强烈表示，他完全不想参与人工智能监管，

cues.en: and he has a lot of very powerful, very wealthy people in tech.
cues.zh: 而科技行业有许多权势显赫、极其富有的人，

cues.en: speaking to him directly quite often and kind of pleading their case that they, you know, really can handle this themselves.
cues.zh: 经常直接与他交谈，替自己陈情，说他们确实可以自行处理。

cues.en: But, you know, Newsom definitely has ties to big tech.
cues.zh: 不过，纽森显然与大型科技企业有联系。

cues.en: He has ties to Meta, he has ties to Google.
cues.zh: 他与Meta和谷歌都有联系。

cues.en: He takes money from these places, so they are political rivals, but they're kind of coming at this from the same group of people.
cues.zh: 他从这些地方获得资金，所以他们虽是政治对手，却似乎都在回应同一群人的诉求。

cues.en: So it will be interesting to see where California actually ends up landing on this, especially as Newsom is leaving office.
cues.zh: 因此，加州最终会在这个问题上采取什么立场，值得关注，尤其是纽森即将离任。

cues.en: Callie Hayes.
cues.zh: 卡莉·海斯。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast, he has proselytized for years the notion of long-term value investing.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后：他多年来一直倡导长期价值投资理念。

cues.en: So the whole idea is to hold on to companies and investments for decades.
cues.zh: 这一理念就是长期持有公司和投资数十年。

cues.en: The sage of Omaha, Warren Buffett, is stepping down from the investment company he's led for more than six decades.
cues.zh: “奥马哈先知”沃伦·巴菲特将卸任这家由他领导了六十多年的投资公司。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Protesters outside Turkey's embassy in London on Friday.
cues.zh: 周五，抗议者聚集在土耳其驻伦敦大使馆外。

cues.en: They're angry at a crackdown on the LGBTQ community ordered by the Turkish president, Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
cues.zh: 他们对土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安下令打压LGBTQ群体感到愤怒。

cues.en: Hundreds of people have been detained across Turkey this week following sweeping government raids.
cues.zh: 本周，土耳其各地在政府大规模突袭后已有数百人被拘留。

cues.en: Emily Withers is a journalist covering the story in Turkey. She spoke to Sean Lay.
cues.zh: 艾米莉·威瑟斯是一名报道土耳其这起事件的记者。她接受了肖恩·莱的采访。

cues.en: Well, I should start by saying, Sean, that life has been pretty tough for LGBTQI+ people here for some time.
cues.zh: 肖恩，我首先要说的是，LGBTQI+群体在这里的生活艰难已经有一段时间了。

cues.en: So, Pride, for example, in this country has been banned since 2015.
cues.zh: 比如，这个国家的骄傲游行自2015年以来就一直被禁止。

cues.en: Turkey doesn't recognize same-sex marriage, but same-sex relations are not illegal here.
cues.zh: 土耳其不承认同性婚姻，但同性关系在这里并不违法。

cues.en: But what we saw over the weekend and into the start of this week is really unprecedented.
cues.zh: 但我们在上周末和本周初看到的情况确实前所未有。

cues.en: This is a massive crackdown on this community.
cues.zh: 这是对这一群体的大规模打压。

cues.en: So over 160 people were detained.
cues.zh: 超过160人被拘留。

cues.en: Associations were raided, bars which are LGBTQ+ friendly were raided, and then there was this.
cues.zh: 一些协会遭到突袭，支持LGBTQ+群体的酒吧也被突袭，随后出现了这段画面。

cues.en: That was released from the Justice Ministry, which showed police officers searching offices and confiscating rainbow flags.
cues.zh: 画面由司法部发布，显示警察搜查办公室并没收彩虹旗。

cues.en: They say to protect children and family.
cues.zh: 他们称这是为了保护儿童和家庭。

cues.en: And then later in this week, when some of these court cases started happening, these people were being held in pre-trial detention.
cues.zh: 本周晚些时候，随着一些案件开始审理，这些人被拘留候审。

cues.en: There were small protests outside courtrooms in Ankara and Istanbul, and the authorities arrested over 100 people who came out to show solidarity.
cues.zh: 安卡拉和伊斯坦布尔的法庭外出现小规模抗议，当局随后逮捕了100多名声援者。

cues.en: So these events have really sent a chill through the LGBTQ society here, that life for them is about to get a lot harder.
cues.zh: 所以，这些事件让这里的 LGBTQ 群体感到寒意，他们的生活将变得更加艰难。

cues.en: Last year, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan designated 2025 as the Year of the Family, encouraging people to have more children.
cues.zh: 去年，雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安总统将2025年定为“家庭年”，鼓励人们多生孩子。

cues.en: Is he kind of blaming the LGBTQ community in some way for the fact that the birth rate in Turkey has been falling?
cues.zh: 他是否在某种程度上把土耳其出生率下降归咎于 LGBTQ 群体？

cues.en: Yes, that's right. So, like many countries around the world, people in Turkey are not having as many babies as the government would like.
cues.zh: 是的。和世界许多国家一样，土耳其人的生育数量没有达到政府希望的水平。

cues.en: So there's been this Year of the Family last year, that's now been extended by the government here.
cues.zh: 去年有“家庭年”，如今这里的政府又延长了这一活动。

cues.en: So it's a decade where they're going to be pushing people to have at least three children.
cues.zh: 这意味着未来十年，他们将推动人们至少生育三个孩子。

cues.en: And they've partly blamed the drop in people having children here on the LGBTQ+ community.
cues.zh: 他们还把这里生育人数的下降部分归咎于 LGBTQ+ 群体。

cues.en: Erdogan has made many speeches over the last year or so, where he has warned that society risks moral decay
cues.zh: 过去一年左右，埃尔多安多次发表演讲，警告社会面临道德堕落的风险，

cues.en: and that this decay is spreading from individuals to families, and then from families to society.
cues.zh: 并称这种堕落正从个人蔓延到家庭，再从家庭蔓延到社会。

cues.en: The language that the politicians use here now against this community is really quite shocking. It is effectively hate speech.
cues.zh: 如今这里政客针对这一群体使用的语言令人震惊，实际上就是仇恨言论。

cues.en: I mean, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has called LGBTQI people "perverts".
cues.zh: 我的意思是，雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安总统称 LGBTQI 人群为“变态”。

cues.en: We also heard this week from the Justice Minister.
cues.zh: 本周我们还听到了司法部长的说法。

cues.en: He made a statement on his social media account that he had let all police force operations know in the country
cues.zh: 他在社交媒体账号上声明，已通知全国所有警察部门，

cues.en: that they had to look out for any activity that might endanger children, might endanger the family.
cues.zh: 要求他们留意任何可能危害儿童、可能危害家庭的活动。

cues.en: And we have seen the language around this community tightening, life getting harder for them, people being attacked more, they say, on the street.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚看到，针对这一群体的言论正在收紧；他们说，生活更艰难了，街头遭受攻击的人也更多了。

cues.en: I mean, just this week, I went to an LGBTQ+ friendly bar.
cues.zh: 就在本周，我去了一个对 LGBTQ+ 友好的酒吧。

cues.en: I watched a band play that was made up of queer and trans people,
cues.zh: 我看了一支由酷儿和跨性别者组成的乐队演出，

cues.en: and they said that they used to play in venues all around the country,
cues.zh: 他们说，过去曾在全国各地的场所演出，

cues.en: and they're now really struggling to find places to perform because bars simply won't have them.
cues.zh: 但现在很难找到演出场所，因为酒吧根本不愿接纳他们。

cues.en: Emily Withers. Father time always wins.
cues.zh: 艾米莉·威瑟斯。时间老人总会获胜。

cues.en: The words of the billionaire investor and philanthropist, Warren Buffett, in a note to shareholders announcing that he's stepping down as chairman
cues.zh: 亿万富翁投资家兼慈善家沃伦·巴菲特在致股东的信中宣布，他将卸任董事长，

cues.en: of Berkshire Hathaway, the firm he took control of 61 years ago.
cues.zh: 他61年前接手的伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司董事长一职。

cues.en: Mr. Buffett is now 96 years old.
cues.zh: 巴菲特先生如今96岁。

cues.en: He'll remain a member of the board while his son, Howard, becomes the new chairman,
cues.zh: 他将继续担任董事，而他的儿子霍华德将成为新任董事长，

cues.en: overseeing what's now a huge conglomerate worth more than a trillion dollars.
cues.zh: 负责管理如今这家市值超过一万亿美元的大型企业集团。

cues.en: Here's the Sage of Omaha, as he's often called, speaking to the BBC a few years ago.
cues.zh: 以下是几年前接受 BBC 采访的“奥马哈先知”，人们常这样称呼他。

cues.en: the first books I read on investment were actually in my dad's office.
cues.zh: 我最初读的投资书籍，其实都在我父亲的办公室里。

cues.en: Pretty soon, I'd read all the books in the office, and read some of them more than once.
cues.zh: 很快，我读完了办公室里的所有书，有些还读了不止一遍。

cues.en: My dad had various nicknames for me.
cues.zh: 我父亲给我起过各种绰号。

cues.en: He'd call me Fireball sometimes, because I'd start little businesses.
cues.zh: 他有时叫我“火球”，因为我会创办一些小企业。

cues.en: He didn't care about money at all.
cues.zh: 他一点也不在乎钱。

cues.en: He believed very much in having an inner scorecard and never worry about what other people are thinking about you.
cues.zh: 他非常相信要有一份内在的评分表，永远不要担心别人怎么看你。

cues.en: You know, just, just, if you know why you're doing what you're doing, that's good enough.
cues.zh: 你知道，只要你明白自己为什么这样做，那就足够了。

cues.en: I admired everything about him, to the extent that I was absorbing lessons from him without knowing it.
cues.zh: 我钦佩他的一切，不知不觉间一直在吸收他教给我的道理。

cues.en: And the idea that all lives have equal value is something that all three of his children felt since I can remember.
cues.zh: 在我的记忆中，他的三个孩子都认同生命具有同等价值。

cues.en: Amelia Pollard is the US investment correspondent for the Financial Times.
cues.zh: 艾米莉娅·波拉德是《金融时报》驻美国投资记者。

cues.en: She spoke to James Menendez about Warren Buffett's retirement.
cues.zh: 她就沃伦·巴菲特退休一事采访了詹姆斯·梅嫩德斯。

cues.en: Warren Buffett's been planning his succession for decades, and even back in 2011,
cues.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特几十年来一直在规划接班事宜，早在2011年，

cues.en: Howard spoke publicly on 60 Minutes about what that plan would look like
cues.zh: 霍华德就在《60分钟》节目中公开谈到过这项计划，

cues.en: and knew even then that this was the eventual role he would take on with the company.
cues.zh: 那时他就知道，这将是自己最终在公司承担的职责。

cues.en: What can you tell us about Howard? I mean, is he able to fill his father's very big shoes?
cues.zh: 关于霍华德，你能告诉我们什么？他能否胜任父亲留下的重任？

cues.en: Yeah, I mean, I think an important distinction here is that Howard's becoming, you know, head of the board,
cues.zh: 是的，这里一个重要区别是，霍华德将成为董事会负责人，

cues.en: but Greg Abel is already CEO, and took on that role at the beginning of the year.
cues.zh: 但格雷格·阿贝尔已经是首席执行官，并在年初接任了这一职位。

cues.en: So the vision is basically to have Abel running the capital allocation and the business side of things,
cues.zh: 所以总体设想是由阿贝尔负责资本配置和业务方面的工作，

cues.en: you know, all of the operations and the sprawling conglomerate,
cues.zh: 也就是负责所有运营，以及这个庞大的企业集团，

cues.en: you know, that is probably the most famous company in the US at this point, or one of them.
cues.zh: 它如今可能是美国最知名的公司，至少是其中之一。

cues.en: And then Howard's job is more to steward the culture and values of Berkshire.
cues.zh: 而霍华德的工作更多是守护伯克希尔的文化和价值观。

cues.en: And so, you know, Berkshire is a really unique company in that there's a cult-like group of shareholders and investors,
cues.zh: 所以，伯克希尔是一家非常独特的公司，拥有一群近乎狂热的股东和投资者，

cues.en: you know, that travel to Omaha every year for the annual shareholder meeting.
cues.zh: 他们每年都会前往奥马哈参加年度股东大会。

cues.en: And that is part of the responsibility that Howard will take on.
cues.zh: 这也是霍华德将承担的职责之一。

cues.en: And obviously, you know, the Buffett name is synonymous, at this point, with Berkshire Hathaway.
cues.zh: 显然，如今巴菲特这个名字已与伯克希尔·哈撒韦密不可分。

cues.en: So I think, to some extent, it's to have a sense of continuity for investors and shareholders, and in who's leading the company behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，这在一定程度上是为了让投资者和股东感到延续性，也让他们知道谁在幕后领导公司。

cues.en: The Buffett name is also synonymous with a certain style of investing.
cues.zh: 巴菲特这个名字也与某种特定的投资风格同义。

cues.en: I mean, for those who don't follow the ins and outs of Berkshire Hathaway, why did Warren Buffett become such a big name?
cues.zh: 我的意思是，对那些不了解伯克希尔·哈撒韦来龙去脉的人来说，沃伦·巴菲特为什么会成为如此响亮的名字？

cues.en: So he has proselytized for years the notion of long-term value investing.
cues.zh: 多年来，他一直在倡导长期价值投资的理念。

cues.en: So the whole idea is to hold on to companies and investments for decades, to think about the long-term evolution of the economy,
cues.zh: 所以，核心理念是持有公司和投资数十年，思考经济的长期演变，

cues.en: and not about what quick-hit wonders might be popular this year or this month.
cues.zh: 而不是关注今年或本月可能流行的短期热门。

cues.en: And that has really been the spirit and the ethos of the company for many, many years,
cues.zh: 这多年来一直是这家公司的精神和理念，

cues.en: and has really brought on legions of shareholders and investors to also subscribe to that philosophy.
cues.zh: 也确实吸引了大批股东和投资者认同这一理念。

cues.en: Obviously, in 2026, that sort of philosophy has a lot more resonance,
cues.zh: 显然，在2026年，这种理念更有共鸣，

cues.en: and it's quite unique in the age of crypto and AI,
cues.zh: 而且在加密货币和人工智能的时代，这种理念相当独特，

cues.en: and in the world we have seen now, in which the S&P 500 and the broader stock market
cues.zh: 在我们如今所处的这个世界里，标普500指数和更广泛的股市

cues.en: is so intensely driven by these high-value, high-growth AI and tech companies,
cues.zh: 都受到这些高估值、高增长的人工智能和科技公司强力驱动，

cues.en: and Berkshire is a bit antithetical to that model and is in much more the longer-term camp.
cues.zh: 而伯克希尔与这种模式有些相反，更属于长期主义阵营。

cues.en: Yes, and has that meant that the company has suffered relative to others?
cues.zh: 是的。那么这是否意味着公司相较其他企业受到了影响？

cues.en: I mean, it has underperformed compared to the main S&P 500 index, hasn't it?
cues.zh: 我的意思是，它的表现不如标普500主指数，对吧？

cues.en: By quite a margin.
cues.zh: 而且差距相当大。

cues.en: Is that a problem?
cues.zh: 这是个问题吗？

cues.en: It has this year, and I think there are a lot of eyes on Berkshire's stock price.
cues.zh: 今年确实如此，我认为很多人都在关注伯克希尔的股价。

cues.en: The investors that I've spoken to today and in recent months have all said that they are believers
cues.zh: 我今天以及近几个月采访过的投资者都说，他们相信

cues.en: in the long-term plan here and think that Berkshire, historically Buffett and now Greg Abel, are stewards
cues.zh: 这里的长期计划，并认为伯克希尔——过去是巴菲特、现在是格雷格·阿贝尔——是他们资金的守护者，

cues.en: of their money, and they believe there's a longer-term vision beyond just what the stock market's doing this year.
cues.zh: 他们相信，公司有超越股市今年表现的长期愿景。

cues.en: Obviously, there's been intense growth with the S&P 500 index this year and the broader market.
cues.zh: 显然，今年标普500指数和更广泛的市场都经历了强劲增长。

cues.en: There's also been a lot of volatility.
cues.zh: 市场也经历了很大波动。

cues.en: So I think there is the camp of shareholders that are still believers in Berkshire and what's to come,
cues.zh: 所以我认为，有一部分股东仍然相信伯克希尔以及它的未来，

cues.en: and believe not to just focus on what the stock and the shares have done this year.
cues.zh: 相信不应只关注股票和股价今年的表现。

cues.en: Many of them have held shares since the 70s or 80s and 90s, and they want to see
cues.zh: 其中许多人从上世纪70年代、80年代或90年代就持有股票，他们想看看

cues.en: what Greg Abel can do in passing the baton from Warren to this new era, and haven't been, from my understanding so far, too quick to judge.
cues.zh: 格雷格·阿贝尔如何把沃伦的接力棒交给这个新时代；据我目前了解，他们并没有急于下定论。

cues.en: You know, too quick to judge on the share price alone.
cues.zh: 也就是说，不会仅凭股价就过早作出判断。

cues.en: Amelia Pollard, US investment correspondent for the Financial Times.
cues.zh: 《金融时报》美国投资记者阿米莉娅·波拉德的报道。

cues.en: Well, it's happened before, of course.
cues.zh: 当然，这种事以前也发生过。

cues.en: Sometimes with embarrassing results, but officials at the Asian Games in Japan had to apologize quickly after they
cues.zh: 有时结果很尴尬。日本亚运会的官员就曾在他们

cues.en: played the wrong national anthem ahead of a field hockey match, and not any anthem, but the
cues.zh: 在一场曲棍球比赛前播放了错误的国歌后迅速道歉；而且不是任意一首国歌，而是

cues.en: North Korean one, when the team on the pitch were from South Korea.
cues.zh: 朝鲜的国歌，场上的球队却来自韩国。

cues.en: Carla Conte reports.
cues.zh: 卡拉·孔蒂报道。

cues.en: Lined up before the match, the players from the South Korean men's hockey team looked around in confusion as the wrong anthem rang out
cues.zh: 比赛开始前列队时，韩国男子曲棍球队的球员困惑地环顾四周，错误的国歌在

cues.en: around the arena, while others, not realizing what had happened, kept a hand on their chest.
cues.zh: 场馆内响起；其他人没有意识到发生了什么，仍把手放在胸前。

cues.en: The stadium announcer was quick to apologize for the mistake.
cues.zh: 体育场播音员很快为这一错误道歉。

cues.en: We are really sorry, terribly sorry.
cues.zh: 我们真的很抱歉，非常抱歉。

cues.en: National anthem for Republic of Korea, we played a different song.
cues.zh: 这是大韩民国的国歌，我们播放了另一首歌。

cues.en: This comes off the back of an earlier incident in the Asian Games, where a Japanese warlord, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, was
cues.zh: 此前亚运会还发生过一件事：一名日本军阀丰臣秀吉被

cues.en: featured during a welcoming ceremony in Nagoya.
cues.zh: 安排出现在名古屋的一场欢迎仪式上。

cues.en: This prompted South Korea's Olympic Committee to file a complaint with the organizers, as Hideyoshi's invasions
cues.zh: 这促使韩国奥委会向主办方提出投诉，因为丰臣秀吉入侵

cues.en: of Korea in the 16th century remain a sensitive chapter for Seoul.
cues.zh: 16世纪的韩国，至今仍是首尔敏感的一段历史。

cues.en: But these are just the latest of a number of controversies emerging from this year's
cues.zh: 但这只是今年亚运会出现的众多争议中最新的一起，

cues.en: Asian Games, where organizers have sought to cut costs by ditching the traditional athletes' village.
cues.zh: 主办方为削减成本，放弃了传统的运动员村。

cues.en: Instead, some 17,000 competitors and officials are being housed in alternative accommodations,
cues.zh: 相反，大约1.7万名运动员和官员被安排在替代性住宿中，

cues.en: including an Italian cruise ship and shipping-container-style cabins.
cues.zh: 包括一艘意大利邮轮和集装箱式客舱。

cues.en: This has led to massive delays and chaos for the teams arriving from all over Asia,
cues.zh: 这给从亚洲各地抵达的队伍造成了严重延误和混乱，

cues.en: with players experiencing grueling waits upon arrival, and some being forced to sleep on the floor while their rooms were being prepared.
cues.zh: 运动员抵达后要经历漫长等待，有些人在房间准备好前被迫睡在地板上。

cues.en: Basketball players also voiced their discomfort, with athletes over two metres tall complaining that their beds were not big enough to accommodate them.
cues.zh: 篮球运动员也表达了不适：身高超过两米的运动员抱怨床铺不够大，无法容纳他们。

cues.en: Carla Conti with that report, and we should add that hearing the wrong national anthem
cues.zh: 卡拉·孔蒂的报道。我们还应补充说，听到错误的国歌

cues.en: didn't ruin things for the South Korean men's field hockey team; they won their match against
cues.zh: 并没有影响韩国男子场地曲棍球队的发挥；他们赢下了对阵

cues.en: Bangladesh 5-0.
cues.zh: 孟加拉国队的比赛，以5比0获胜。

cues.en: Now let's stick to the topic of games, but games of another kind.
cues.zh: 现在让我们继续谈游戏，不过是另一种游戏。

cues.en: Some believe the board game Monopoly takes too long to play because it can go on for hours or even days with no clear winner.
cues.zh: 有人认为，桌游《大富翁》耗时太久，因为它可能持续数小时甚至数天，却没有明确的赢家。

cues.en: But there is another game that's so detailed and complex that it's almost certain that no one has ever completed it.
cues.zh: 但还有另一款游戏，它如此详尽复杂，几乎可以肯定从来没人完成过。

cues.en: The game in question is called Campaign for North Africa, and two friends in Britain have taken on the task of playing it to its conclusion—
cues.zh: 这款游戏名为《北非战役》，英国的两位朋友决定把它玩到最后——

cues.en: something they estimate could take several years, or even decades.
cues.zh: 他们估计这可能要花上数年，甚至数十年。

cues.en: The newsroom's Pete Ross picks up the story.
cues.zh: 新闻编辑部的皮特·罗斯继续报道。

cues.en: You've perhaps been there. Someone gets a new board game, maybe for Christmas, and one of the family takes it upon themselves.
cues.zh: 你或许经历过这种情况：有人得到一款新桌游，也许是圣诞节礼物，于是家里有个人主动承担起这件事。

cues.en: To read the rules and explain them to everybody else.
cues.zh: 他要读懂规则，再向其他人解释。

cues.en: You're hopefully up and playing within a few minutes, until everyone gets bored or falls out. If you're very lucky, you might play to the end.
cues.zh: 希望几分钟内大家就能开始玩，直到所有人感到无聊或闹翻。如果你非常走运，也许能玩到最后。

cues.en: Well, what about a game that's so convoluted and cumbersome that it can take years—
cues.zh: 那么，有没有一款游戏复杂又笨重，可能要花上好几年——

cues.en: just to learn the rules, I think? Why were we mad enough to do it, I think?
cues.zh: 我想，光是学会规则就要好几年。我们到底为什么会疯狂到要做这件事？

cues.en: If we understood wargames better, or the scale of it, we might have been scared off. That's Andrew Tiger.
cues.zh: 如果我们更了解兵棋，或者了解它的规模，可能早就被吓退了。这是安德鲁·泰格。

cues.en: He and James Purcell, friends from Newcastle upon Tyne in northern England, have spent nearly two years mastering the rules and preparing to play it.
cues.zh: 他和来自英格兰北部泰恩河畔纽卡斯尔的朋友詹姆斯·珀塞尔，花了近两年熟悉规则，准备开始这款游戏。

cues.en: It covers the conflict in North Africa during the Second World War.
cues.zh: 它涵盖第二次世界大战期间的北非战事。

cues.en: Only now do the pair feel confident they know the rules of this military strategy game, first released in the 1970s, well enough to play for real.
cues.zh: 直到现在，两人才确信自己已经熟悉这款军事策略游戏的规则，足以真正开始对局；它最早在20世纪70年代发行。

cues.en: The two are, it'll come as no surprise, board-game enthusiasts.
cues.zh: 不出所料，两人都是桌游爱好者。

cues.en: And while discussing their hobby with a friend one night, they learned about a game that legend claimed had never been completed, explains James.
cues.zh: 一天晚上，他们和朋友聊起这个爱好，得知有一款传说中从未被完成的游戏，詹姆斯解释道。

cues.en: And we thought nothing of it until a few weeks later. One of us said to the other, "Have you been thinking about that game a lot?"
cues.zh: 我们当时没太在意，直到几周后，其中一人问另一人：“你是不是一直在想那款游戏？”

cues.en: And over the course of the next couple of hours, we decided we were going to buy the game, play the game in its entirety,
cues.zh: 接下来几个小时里，我们决定买下这款游戏，把它完整玩一遍，

cues.en: and record a podcast alongside it, so that we had a reason to stay on topic and be really accountable to finish it.
cues.zh: 同时录制一档播客，这样就有理由专注于游戏，并真正对完成它负责。

cues.en: Given just how much detail the game goes into, it's perhaps not surprising that no one has ever seen it through to the end.
cues.zh: 考虑到这款游戏的细节如此之多，难怪从来没人玩到过最后。

cues.en: Much of the time playing the game is spent on logistical concerns. Do your troops have enough ammunition?
cues.zh: 玩这款游戏的大部分时间都花在后勤问题上：你的部队有足够弹药吗？

cues.en: And don't forget to supply them with sufficient rations, as you keep track of food and water supplies.
cues.zh: 别忘了给他们提供足够的口粮，还要记录食物和水的供应。

cues.en: It can all get a bit much, says James.
cues.zh: 詹姆斯说，这一切有时会让人不堪重负。

cues.en: I've had many a time when I've been invited to a social event and had to tell them that I can't, because—
cues.zh: 很多次有人邀请我参加社交活动，我却不得不告诉他们我去不了，因为——

cues.en: I've got to go and play a game that I don't particularly enjoy playing, and fill out some spreadsheets.
cues.zh: 我得去玩一款其实不太喜欢的游戏，还要填一些电子表格。

cues.en: If you're playing as an Italian unit, you'll need more water than troops from other nations, as you need it, according to the rules, to boil pasta.
cues.zh: 如果你扮演意大利部队，所需的水会比其他国家的部队更多，因为按规则你需要用水煮意大利面。

cues.en: And that water can also evaporate at varying rates, depending on how hot or cold the weather is that turn.
cues.zh: 而且水的蒸发速度也会不同，取决于该回合的天气冷热。

cues.en: And those are just some of the less puzzling rules.
cues.zh: 这些还只是没那么令人费解的规则。

cues.en: The small moments, like the air combat, are quite fun, where you get to have dogfights between planes,
cues.zh: 其中也有一些小片段很有趣，比如空战，你可以让飞机之间展开缠斗，

cues.en: but since most of it is just a logistics simulator, I think, if—
cues.zh: 但大部分内容只是后勤模拟器，我想，如果——

cues.en: anyone finds that fun, I'm not sure they understand games in the conventional definition.
cues.zh: 有人觉得这很有趣，我不确定他们是否理解通常所说的游戏。

cues.en: James there again. There's an awful lot to get your head around.
cues.zh: 詹姆斯又说道，这款游戏有太多东西需要理解。

cues.en: But if you fancy playing yourself and need guidance or help with the rules, there aren't many resources out there.
cues.zh: 但如果你想亲自玩，又需要规则指导或帮助，网上可用的资源并不多。

cues.en: The game itself has been out of print for years, and its publisher went out of business some time ago.
cues.zh: 这款游戏已经绝版多年，而它的出版商也早已倒闭。

cues.en: The game's designer, Richard Berg, who admitted he'd never finished the game, died in 2019.
cues.zh: 这款游戏的设计师理查德·伯格曾承认自己从未完成它，并于2019年去世。

cues.en: So, James and Andrew will be pretty much on their own when they begin playing the game for real later this month.
cues.zh: 所以，詹姆斯和安德鲁本月晚些时候真正开始游戏时，基本只能靠自己。

cues.en: But they'll have plenty of time to learn the game as they play, says Andrew. At our current pace, it'll probably take about two decades.
cues.zh: 但正如安德鲁解释的，他们可以边玩边学习，有充足时间。按目前的速度，可能要花大约二十年。

cues.en: We hopefully speed that up a little bit, but if we get it done in less than 10 years, we've done very well.
cues.zh: 希望我们能把进度稍微加快，但如果能在十年内完成，就已经非常成功了。

cues.en: Given their one practice game, which in comparison took just a few weeks to complete, ended in a draw,
cues.zh: 他们曾进行过一场练习赛，只花了几周就完成，最后以平局收场，

cues.en: they'll be hoping for a more satisfying conclusion.
cues.zh: 他们希望这次能有更令人满意的结局。

cues.en: I mean, the main question I get is, "Why?" Like, "Just why are you doing this?" And I don't have a great answer.
cues.zh: 我最常被问的问题是：“为什么？”比如：“你到底为什么要做这件事？”我没有很好的答案。

cues.en: Just don't ask if they're up for a rematch. Pete Ross.
cues.zh: 只是别问他们是否想再来一局。皮特·罗斯报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now. If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 以上就是目前的全部内容。如需联系我们，可发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service. Use the hashtag #GlobalNewsPod.
cues.zh: 你也可以在 X 上关注 BBC World Service。请使用话题标签 #GlobalNewsPod。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Johnny Hall. The editor is Karen Martin. I'm Celia Hatton. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 本期《Global News Podcast》由约翰尼·霍尔混音。编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是西莉娅·哈顿。下次再见。
